The spec must declare what would un-falsify A1: the conditioning variable, the estimand, the population, the forward-chained cuts, and the falsifier. It must be written BEFORE DISC-2 measures anything, or DISC-2 is exploratory rather than confirmatory.

queue.description: All 864 configurations fall within one standard error of the best in both classes, so the pre-registered tie-break does 100% of the selecting and the data does none of it. The SE in the one-SE rule is the standard error of the mean ACROSS FOLDS, and fold-to-fold variation swamps configuration-to-configuration variation by roughly twenty to one. A PAIRED comparison — same folds, differenced per configuration — would have a far smaller standard error and might discriminate.
queue.blocker: none — but changing the rule is a change to the pre-registration and is a new pre-registration, not an edit to the old one.
